{{Quote|I remember when he lost his duel with Marka Ragnos&hellip;|Naga Sadow, to the Sith Council after Simus's death|<ref name="Tales 3" />}}
In approximately [[5100 BBY/Legends|5100 BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> a '''duel''' was fought between the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lords]] [[Marka Ragnos]] and [[Simus]],<ref name="Tales 3" /> who had been competing<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|III|152|Simus}}</ref> in a power struggle<ref name="Behind the Magic" /> for the title of [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord]] of the [[Sith Empire/Legends|Sith Empire]]<ref name="Tales 3" /> since [[5200 BBY]].<ref name="Behind the Magic" /> Simus challenged Ragnos but was [[Sai cha/Legends|beheaded]] by his opponent during the [[Lightsaber duel/Legends|duel]].<ref name="CSWE" /> Rather than succumb to his injuries,<ref name="Tales 3" /> Simus used [[Sith sorcery/Legends|Sith magic]] to keep himself alive. His head was preserved in a [[Crystal/Legends|crystal]] sphere and he served as an [[Advisor/Legends|advisor]] to Ragnos until the Dark Lord's [[Death/Legends|death]]<ref name="CSWE" /> in [[5000 BBY/Legends|5000 BBY]].<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> Simus was killed later that [[Standard year/Legends|year]] in a [[First raid on the Sith Citadel|false-flag attack]] by his former pupil [[Naga Sadow/Legends|Naga Sadow]], who subsequently recalled the memory of Simus's loss to Ragnos to the [[Sith Council]] in order to motivate them to [[Great Hyperspace War/Legends|retaliate]] against the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="Tales 3" />

==Behind the scenes==
The duel between Marka Ragnos and Simus was first mentioned in the [[Tales of the Jedi – The Golden Age of the Sith 3|third issue]] of [[Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi – The Golden Age of the Sith|''The Golden Age of the Sith'']], an arc in the [[Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi (comic series)|''Tales of the Jedi'']] [[Star Wars comic books|comic]] series. The comic was written by [[Kevin J. Anderson]] and published by [[Dark Horse Comics]]<ref name="Tales 3" /> on [[December 11]], [[1996]].<ref name="Marvel3">{{Marvel|url=comics/issue/54592/star_wars_tales_of_the_jedi_-_the_golden_age_of_the_sith_1996_3|text=Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi - The Golden Age of the Sith (1996) #3}}</ref> The comic states that Simus lost the duel [[Standard century/Legends|centuries]] before its events<ref name="Tales 3" /> in 5000 BBY,<ref name="NEC" /> however, later sources such as the [[1998]] [[LucasArts]] CD-ROM ''[[Star Wars: Behind the Magic]]''<ref name="Behind the Magic" /> and the [[2008]] reference book ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'' suggest that Simus only lived as a disembodied head for a century.<ref name="CSWE" /> This article follows the latter sources.
